# agentic-canvas

A shared whiteboard for diagrams, drawn by people and agents.

Keywords: whiteboard,canvas,diagrams,drawing,collaboration,agents,mcp,cli.

- SDK: import { Board, drawFlow, readBoard, toSvg } from "agentic-canvas".
- CLI: agentic-canvas new|read|add|connect|move|rm|flow|export.

## Docs

- README: https://github.com/pooriaarab/agentic-canvas
